content: Note that when the head entity is a very specific entity like Louis Costello, our method is very accurate at predicting the correct tail entity (in this case Comedian). TransE, on the other hand, makes very poor predictions on such cases. We believe that our method is able to model such cases better because our embeddings, especially for such specific entities, have captured the rich context associated with them from entire paths.
